scientific_integrity: The stated all-parameter ratio classification follows analytically from a positive exact interchange factor. The three-stage counterexample is an exact finite computation, not a general no-algorithm theorem. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: A fixed multiset of positive-duration, known, piecewise-constant exponential-rate environments; no mortality, irreversible transition chain; three-stage obstruction is to context-free local comparisons only; model is not field calibrated.
title: A universal rate-ratio sorting law and a sharp three-stage obstruction in sequential development
